# seawise-tunnel/1 test vectors

Generated by the `vectors_gen_test.go` file of the package that verifies
them; regenerate with `UPDATE_VECTORS=1 go test ./...`. Every key is derived
from the published seed `SHA-256("seawise test vector key: " + name)` and is
for tests only.

| File | Package | Covers |
|---|---|---|
| `control_frames.json` | wire | stream 0 framing, envelope, every message kind and field cap |
| `stream_header.json` | wire | data-stream header and reply |
| `hello.json` | handshake | Hello checks, signed HelloAck, supersede decision |
| `negotiation.json` | handshake | minor and capability negotiation, digest echo |
| `relay.json` | handshake | peer handshake transcripts, relay prefix |
| `request_bytes.json` | httpwire | one request per stream, smuggling cases, h2 fields, upgrades |
| `routeset.json` | claims | RouteSet claims and the signed time it carries |
| `flags.json` | claims | flags evaluation, rollback, caps |
| `signed_state.json` | claims | device state bound to server, key and nonce (`sw-state+jwt`) |
| `device_call.json` | claims | relayed call to DPoP binding, dedupe outcomes |
| `ladder.json` | ladder | transport ladder event sequences |

Cases with `"layer": "frame"` check only the length prefix. No valid message
reaches the 65536-byte control frame cap or the 4096-byte header cap, so the
cases at exactly those lengths are frame-layer only: the frame is accepted
and its content is not a valid message.

The vectors do not depend on the multiplexer; stream windows and budgets
are covered by the tests in `caps`. The agent buffer budget there is 48 MiB
(initial windows of 128 streams plus a 15.75 MiB growth pool), not the
32 MiB the protocol spec gives; the stream cap of 128 is unchanged.

The paths in `device_call.json` follow the provisional method table in
`wire/device.go` and change if that table changes.
